items.hook: The Broker is a suspense novel written by American author John Grisham and published in the United States on January 11, 2005.
items.body: The novel follows the story of Joel Backman, a newly pardoned prisoner who had tried to broker a deal to sell the world's most powerful satellite surveillance system to the highest bidder. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Franco-Prussian War: Léon Gambetta escapes the siege of Paris in a hot-air balloon.
items.body: Léon Gambetta was a French lawyer and republican politician who proclaimed the Third Republic in 1870 and played a prominent role in its early government. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Soviet probe Luna 3 transmits the first-ever photographs of the far side of the Moon.
items.body: Luna 3, or E-2A No.1, was a Soviet spacecraft launched in 1959 as part of the Luna programme. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The Mameyes landslide kills almost 200 people in Puerto Rico.
items.body: The 1985 Puerto Rico floods produced showers and thunderstorms across the island and the deadliest single landslide on record on United States territory, that killed at least 130 people in the Mameyes neighborhood of barrio Portugués Urbano in Ponce. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: World War II: The Sonderkommando Revolt in Auschwitz was an uprising of prisoners (especially the Sonderkommando) at the Auschwitz concentration camp, they burnt down Crematorium IV.
items.body: The Auschwitz Sonderkommando revolt occurred on 7 October 1944, when a large group of Sonderkommando members in the crematoria area of Birkenau camp rebelled against the SS guards of the camp. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: The charter for the Province of Massachusetts Bay is issued.
items.body: The Province of Massachusetts Bay was a colony in New England which became one of the thirteen original states of the United States. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Pig Island is a 2006 novel by British writer Mo Hayder.
items.body: The novel is nominally a thriller which mixes elements of the detective novel with more overt horror influences. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Weir of Hermiston is an 1896 unfinished novel by Robert Louis Stevenson.
items.body: It is markedly different from his previous works in style and has often been praised as a potential masterpiece. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: Aeroflot Flight 1080 crashes after takeoff from Koltsovo International Airport, killing 38.
items.body: Aeroflot Flight 1080 was a Soviet domestic passenger flight from Sverdlovsk, Russia, to Dzhambul, Kazakhstan, that crashed at night shortly after takeoff on 7 October 1978. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
